title: %merge — shallow merge of two objects
purpose: Combine two objects, with the second object's properties overriding the first.
notes: Both arguments are objects; the result is a new object serialized as a {.m} sub-section.
Keys in the second object override matching keys in the first (role becomes "admin"); the originals are untouched.
The merge is shallow — nested objects are replaced, not deep-merged.
